resume.title: Professional summary
resume.headline: .NET Software Engineer | C# · .NET Core · Azure · SQL Server · Microservices
resume.profile: Backend-focused Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, building, and maintaining .NET applications and SQL Server-based solutions across insurance, financial services, and government sectors. Over the past two years, focused on Clean Architecture and microservices, including hands-on work with Azure Functions, Service Bus, and Blob Storage at Globant. Strong background in troubleshooting, performance optimization, and delivering features within Agile/Scrum teams, including work with distributed and remote teams in the U.S. and Europe. Experienced with Microsoft Azure and AWS cloud services, RESTful APIs, and service integration (MongoDB, Mulesoft). Comfortable owning PBIs end-to-end, from estimation through deployment, with a strong sense of accountability and continuous improvement.
